rows.author: I051
rows.title_full:
AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 386,   
ALSO KNOWN AS THE CIVIL CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES,   
ARTICLE 952
rows.abstract:
Seeks to establish the fact that an heir is no longer the continuation of the personality of the deceased and therefore does not assume responsibility for the obligations of the decedent.
Intends to amend Art. 952 of the Civil Code (which mentions a charge of a legacy or a devise upon an heir), to be read as follows:
“The heir or the executor or administrator of the estate must deliver the very thing bequeathed if he is liable to do so and cannot discharge this obligation by paying its value. . .”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2021-01-20

rows.author: I051
rows.title_full:
AN ACT DEFINING THE CRIME OF STALKING   
AND PROVIDING THE PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Prescribes punishable acts when can a person be accused of stalking:  when he harasses another: by making repeated unsolicited calls...; making repeated communications anonymously or at extremely inconvenient hours, or in an offensively coarse language; making repeated visits to the victims' home or workplace; following or repeatedly maintain visual or physical proximity...;  and engaging in any other course of alarming conduct.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2021-01-20

rows.author: I051
rows.title_full:
AN ACT DEFINING WHO ARE INSTITUTIONALIZED PERSONS   
AND PENALIZING THEIR MALTREATMENT
rows.abstract:
Seeks to ensure that institutionalized persons not be subjected to shabby and abusive treatment from the people charged with their care and custody.

Refers “institutionalized persons” to persons kept in an institution (any facility owned or managed by, or provides services on behalf of the government which employs skilled nursing, provides intermediate or long-term care, or custodial or residential care) who are:
1.)  Mentally ill, disabled, or retarded, or chronically ill or handicapped; 
2.)  in jail, either by final sentence or under detention; and
3.)  Juveniles, under certain conditions.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HUMAN RIGHTS since 2021-01-20

rows.author: I051
rows.title_full:
AN ACT MANDATING CONCURRENCE TO INTERNATIONAL AGREEMENTS AND 
EXECUTIVE AGREEMENTS
rows.abstract:
Seeks to reassert the power of the President in his dealing and relations with other countries or his exercise of a treaty-making power as Chief Executive.
Proposes concurrence by the Senate to international and executive agreements - to ensure that any commitment made by the President, whether bilateral or multilateral arrangements, will not threaten our national security and interests.
Prescribes agreements that do not need Senate concurrence which includes among others:  the power to receive foreign ambassadors and recognize foreign governments; and to authorize the sending of medical missions for humanitarian reasons; the power as Commander-in-Chief of the AFP, with the exception of the deployment of military troops to any foreign country, and those that involve other forms of military assistance.

AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 18, 22, 24, 26 and 28 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 3591, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE
PHILIPPINE DEPOSIT INSURANCE CORPORATION CHARTER  AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Proposes to centralize with the BSP, the PDIC power on bank resolution that include the grant of consent to mergers and acquisitions and the issuance of cease-and-desist orders about deposit-related unsafe and/or unsound banking.
Seeks to authorize the Board of Directors to increase the maximum deposit insurance coverage when financial stability is at stake,  based on empirical and actuarial studies, inflation, or other economic indicators.
Intends to authorize PDIC to set up deposit insurance schemes to protect users of new financial products and depositors in Islamic banks.
Proposes to ensure better policy and program coordination between agencies by attaching the PDIC to the BSP (from the DOF).
rows.status: Substituted by HB08818
